description: This PHP file defines a unit test class 'EmployeeCSVImportAPITest' for testing the 'EmployeeCSVImportAPI' class in the OrangeHRM project. It includes test methods for delete, get validation rules, get all records, create, and validates the creation process involving file import functionality.

classes.name: EmployeeCSVImportAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeCSVImportAPI endpoints related to CSV data import functionality in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that calling delete on the API raises a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving validation rules for delete raises a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Verifies that calling getAll raises a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving validation rules for getAll raises a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks that the validation rules for creating an import contain correct attachment parameters including size and type constraints.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the CSV import process, ensuring that the import service is called and the response meta-data reflects success.
